decisions.reason: Because submarine interior lighting is relatively distant from the firm's core lighting knowledge base and shows no clear sign of follow-on development, management would be more likely to redeploy resources to products where its absorptive capacity is stronger.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit closely with the firm's established industrial lighting capabilities, and the LED replacement kit introduced after launch shows active learning and improvement based on related knowledge.

The designer task light is close to the firm's existing offer and its relaunch as a popular product suggests the firm can effectively refresh and support it using accumulated design and engineering experience.
The pendant office luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core professional building-lighting domain, where its engineering, customer insight and R&D make continued commercialization likely.

Although the premium pendant luminaire may be somewhat more niche, it still builds on the firm's established competencies in professional lighting and is therefore more likely to be retained than discontinued.
